objective: Make Android Wall photos display quickly from existing disk cache on weak signal while keeping ongoing network transfers intact, with bounded fallback and manual Retry
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: October 29 source main b83c7c9477b627d1f7ff7b944ccefdf047b46b99 restored native direct-rendering after Oct 28 regression. Live Supabase community_post_media read-only size audit 1,125 images median 500,946 bytes and 90th percentile 2,067,747 bytes, with 108 over 2 MiB. Infinix X6852 successful signed 200 downloads coexist with blank/slow UI. Native handset OTA fingerprint is not independently verified.
acceptanceChecks: Never replace a still-progressing low-bandwidth image after a fixed eight-second timer
Prefer validated native disk cache under the same path cache key when feed returns authorized media path
A corrupted local file falls back to authenticated signed network URL once
No opaque loading layer and no recyclingKey that blanks native image
Only a true no-progress/decode-without-display condition triggers independent renderer fallback
Every unfinished load transitions to visible retry state after 90 seconds, not infinite loading
No new RPC polling, paid services, database mutation, app rebuild, web/iOS behavior or generic media changes
Focused behavioral tests plus Engineering Accountability, TypeScript/Performance and Integration QA pass before exact-source RC and production OTA
